claim.section: What I know that they don't

support.quote: Vee doesn't know she was chosen — the "pointing game," the staged quad "collision"

Vee does not know that Pace and Randi were already lovers before she met either of them together, or that her apparent chance meeting with Randi began with Pace pointing her out and telling Randi to meet her.

claim.text: Vee does not know that Pace and Randi deliberately selected her through the pointing game and Randi engineered their collision.
